about: measure contests of 2016 in Alaska, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, State Precinct-Level Returns 2016 (Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/GSZG1O) and Local Precinct-Level Returns 2016 (Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/Q8OHRS)
medsl.note: MEDSL's older layout, read for its questions only by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py 2016; files 2016-precinct-state.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

threshold.rule: majority of the votes cast on the proposition (exactly half is not a majority)
threshold.quote: If a majority of the votes cast on the proposition favor the amendment, it shall be adopted.
threshold.matched: the source's title does not give the type; every rule read for the state's measures (but its convention question) sets this threshold

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (0) for the class 'statewide measure'
